title.description: Short working title for the reel, under 8 words

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the reel shows and its point

hook.description: Exactly what happens and is said or shown in the first 3 seconds

beats.description: Each distinct shot or moment, in order

onScreenText.description: Text overlay shown during this beat, verbatim, or empty

audio.description: Voiceover, dialogue or notable sound in this beat, or empty

spokenWords.description: Full transcript of any speech or voiceover, or empty

onScreenText.description: Every text overlay, verbatim, in order

audio.description: Music or sound: genre, energy, whether it is a trending-style track or original audio

setting.description: Where it was filmed, as specifically as can be seen

mood.description: The feeling the reel is going for

callToAction.description: Any call to action in the video itself, or empty

plainDescription.description: One paragraph describing the reel for someone who cannot see it, specific enough to write a caption from
